blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks edged lower on Friday, extending their losing streak to five sessions as high oil prices, elevated Treasury yields, and a weak peso weighed on investor sentiment. The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) slipped 0.01 percent, or 0.44 point, to close at 5,629.03.
